key_point: Why Kratos suddenly became a dad
title: Why Kratos suddenly became a dad
caption: Cory Barlog has said becoming a father shaped Kratos's new story in God of War (2018). #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #godofwar #kratos

instagram.caption:
Cory Barlog had a son while planning the new God of War, and he has said fatherhood shaped the whole game.

Kratos went from pure rage to a dad struggling to raise Atreus without passing on his own mistakes.

When the glowing reviews arrived, Barlog posted a video of himself breaking down in tears. Years of risk had paid off.

Did the ending get you?
